description: Windenergieanlage (Potenzial) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rips-dienste.lubw.baden-wuerttemberg.de. These are data from the nationwide model calculation of wind potential based on the Baden-Württemberg Wind Atlas 2019 in conjunction with the criteria catalogue, in which exclusion areas and areas with known restrictions were determined. In the list of criteria, the exclusion areas are described as "mainly unsuitable", the restriction areas as "conditionally suitable". Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbine (potential)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include oac: 705, Klima, Umweltschutz, Energie. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-02-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
